description: This Java class provides helper methods for managing the mapping between loan products and general ledger (GL) accounts within the Fineract accounting module. It includes functions for saving, merging, updating, and deleting account mappings, as well as handling different accounting rules and payment channels specific to loan products.

classes.name: LoanProductToGLAccountMappingHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing loan product to GL account mappings, including saving, merging, updating, and deleting account mappings, with support for different accounting rules and payment channels.

methods.name: saveLoanToAssetAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping from a loan product to an asset account based on JSON input.

methods.name: saveLoanToAssetOrLiabilityAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping from a loan product to either an asset or liability account, depending on JSON input.

methods.name: saveLoanToIncomeAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping from a loan product to an income account.

methods.name: saveLoanToExpenseAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping from a loan product to an expense account.

methods.name: saveLoanToLiabilityAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping from a loan product to a liability account.

methods.name: mergeLoanToAssetAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to a loan product's asset account mapping.

methods.name: mergeLoanToAssetOrLiabilityAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to a loan product's asset or liability account mapping.

methods.name: mergeLoanToIncomeAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to a loan product's income account mapping.

methods.name: mergeLoanToExpenseAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to a loan product's expense account mapping.

methods.name: mergeLoanToLiabilityAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to a loan product's liability account mapping.

methods.name: savePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Saves payment channel to fund source mappings for a loan product.

methods.name: updatePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Updates payment channel to fund source mappings for a loan product.

methods.name: saveChargesToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Saves charge mappings to income accounts for a loan product.

methods.name: saveChargeOffReasonToExpenseAccountMappings
methods.description: Saves charge-off reasons to expense accounts.

methods.name: saveWriteOffReasonToExpenseAccountMappings
methods.description: Saves write-off reasons to expense accounts.

methods.name: updateWriteOffReasonToExpenseAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates write-off reasons to expense accounts.

methods.name: updateChargeOffReasonToExpenseAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates charge-off reasons to expense accounts.

methods.name: saveCapitalizedIncomeClassificationToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Saves capitalized income classification to income account mappings.

methods.name: updateCapitalizedIncomeClassificationToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates capitalized income classification to income account mappings.

methods.name: saveBuyDownFeeClassificationToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Saves buy-down fee classification to income account mappings.

methods.name: updateBuyDownFeeClassificationToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates buy-down fee classification to income account mappings.

methods.name: updateChargesToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates charges to income account mappings for a loan product.

methods.name: populateChangesForNewLoanProductToGLAccountMappingCreation
methods.description: Prepares a map of changes for creating new loan product to GL account mappings based on JSON input and accounting rule.

methods.name: populateChangesForAccrualBasedAccounting
methods.description: Populates change map for accrual-based accounting with specific account IDs.

methods.name: populateChangesForCashBasedAccounting
methods.description: Populates change map for cash-based accounting with specific account IDs.

methods.name: handleChangesToLoanProductToGLAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates account mappings for a loan product based on JSON input and accounting rules, including optional features like income capitalization and buy-down fees.

methods.name: deleteLoanProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Deletes all GL account mappings for a specific loan product.

methods.name: getGLAccountType
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the GL account type from JSON input, ensuring it is within allowed types.
